associativity_reason: word concatenation is strictly associative; algebraic evaluation is compatible because iterated fiber products are canonically associative and local cut evaluation is ideal-sum/intersection composition.

forgetful_maps.mu_alg_to_cycle_N: sum of path coefficients weighted by exact algebraic intersection multiplicity

ordinary_correspondence_compatibility: evaluation of concatenated typed path equals composition of its ordinary algebraic operations on every frozen valid witness
path_formal_sum: free finite N-sum on typed path witnesses with matching source/target
path_witness: finite typed word of concrete algebraic cut/fiber/push operations with section labels, intermediate ideals, line chart, and fiber parameter provenance

INC_PUSH: P_2 -> X_2 by proper cycle pushforward q_*

incidence fiber product P x_F Z over an F-cycle Z
proper q-pushforward cycle on X when dimension/codimension obligation passes
